d: The OCC crew has a special mission: complete the Sunoco Chopper in time for a charity auction supporting the Victory Junction Gang Camp! Working alongside racing legend Kyle Petty, Paul Jr., Rick Petko and the team bring NASCAR-inspired design, bold blue-and-yellow graphics and custom craftsmanship together. But with the deadline approaching, every minute counts as the crew races to finish this extraordinary motorcycle. Watch American Chopper Season 3 Episode 71 only on discovery+ India.
